title: Advances in the quantum-state texture theory
summary: The recently introduced concept of quantum-state texture (QST) has found applications ranging from the identification of unknown quantum gates to the study of quantum phase transitions and criticality, and has already been experimentally investigated. Here, we advance its resource-theoretic formulation in several directions. Our approach centers on the experimentally accessible grand sum--the sum of all matrix elements of a density operator in a given basis.
